ui_bugs.component: ReportBetaPage – MOVIMENTAZIONE FINANZIARIA non-VERS cash inputs (ALTRO/GLO/JUST/DEL/BP/SAT/POS/FT/ARR)
ui_bugs.issue: Rose/red 'formula' visual highlight does NOT appear when the input contains an arithmetic expression. Root cause at line 1186: `const isFormula = isVers && isFormulaExpr(rawVal)` — the `isVers &&` makes isFormula always false for every cash field except VERS, so the className branch `isFormula && focusedField === f.key ? 'bg-rose-100 ...'` (line 1228) never fires. Calculation itself works correctly (evaluateValue computes the value, CASH SERA total updates), but the user-requested visual hint is missing. Should be `const isFormula = isFormulaExpr(rawVal);` (drop the `isVers &&`).

When the user types a NEGATIVE plain number (e.g. '-3') on an op=plus field like ALTRO, the small caption below the input shows '+€3,00' (line 1247 uses field's static sign + Math.abs(computed)). The CASH SERA total IS computed correctly (subtracts 3) so the math is fine, but the caption text is misleading — it should reflect the effective sign (e.g. '−€3,00' on a plus-field when the value is negative).

critical_code_review_comments: Line 1186: `const isFormula = isVers && isFormulaExpr(rawVal);` should be `const isFormula = isFormulaExpr(rawVal);` so all editable cash fields get the rose-100 'formula' highlight (the comment at line 81-92 says isFormulaExpr is supposed to detect any formula on any field).

Line 1247 (small caption): consider using the EFFECTIVE sign of (op * computed) instead of `${sign}€${Math.abs(computed)}` so that a negative typed value on a plus-field is rendered as '−€3,00' to avoid user confusion. Same fix likely needed for VERS branch line 1341.

Persistence behaviour (not deeply tested but observed): the cash-row input stores the RAW expression while focused (e.g. '10+5') and displays the formatted absolute on blur. After a hard refresh I did not have time to fully confirm whether the raw string or the computed value is persisted, but no crash occurred and the page reloaded fine.
action_items: Fix line 1186 in /app/frontend/src/pages/ReportBetaPage.js: drop the `isVers &&` so non-VERS cash inputs (ALTRO, GLO, JUST, DEL, BP, SAT, POS, FT, ARR) also receive the rose-100/border-rose-300 visual highlight when their content is a formula (with or without leading '='). This is the most important regression vs the user's request: 'Visual formula highlight: When the field contains 10+5 (without =), the input background should be rose/red highlighted'.

(Optional, lower priority) Update small caption rendering (lines 1247 & 1341) so the displayed sign reflects (op * computed) instead of the field's static op sign, to avoid '-3 on plus-field shows +€3' confusion.

The MOVIMENTAZIONE wrapper is the next sibling of the h2 with text 'Movimentazione finanziaria' — its inline style is `border: 2px solid rgb(156, 163, 175)`. evaluateValue() in lines 65-79 correctly handles '=expr', 'expr' (no =), comma decimals and negatives. isFormulaExpr() at lines 83-92 correctly returns true for '10+5' and false for '7,5'. The bug is purely in the gate `isVers && isFormulaExpr` on line 1186 — beverage inputs and Spicci inputs use isFormulaExpr directly so they DO highlight correctly.
rca of the issue: Visual highlight regression RCA: developer added isFormulaExpr() helper and updated bev/spicci sections to use it directly, but the legacy line 1186 inside the non-VERS cash render still gates on `isVers && isFormulaExpr(rawVal)`. As a consequence, every non-VERS editable cash cell evaluates isFormula=false, so the conditional className at line 1228 always falls through to the readonly/mattina branches and ends with 'bg-white' instead of 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-800 border-rose-300'. Reproduction: focus ALTRO, type '10+5' → input bg stays rgb(255,255,255). Fix: change line 1186 to `const isFormula = isFormulaExpr(rawVal);` (the VERS-specific palette logic at lines 1250+ already guards with `isVers && !isFormula`, so changing this does not break VERS behaviour).
